typical_titles: Vice Chancellor, Director, Registrar (institutions); CEO, Whole-time Director, Group CEO (edtech)
owns: The budget and the final yes. At IIM Udaipur the Director has the final say on most day-to-day cases.
cares_about: Reach in new languages, cost per admission, brand risk.
blocks_if: He sees no clear cost cut or enrolment gain, or a pilot touches the brand before it is proven.
where_found: Concall participant list; annual report KMP list; institute RTI and leadership page.
label: INFERENCE
